basis.reference: Full functional parity under typed-error/native first-party principles; no silent exclusions or changed outcomes counted as parity
https://github.com/numpy/numpy/blob/a3d0ef1df045b858e68115001fdabc930bb3b68c/numpy/_core/src/common/get_attr_string.h#L36

decision: Preserve exact NumPy special-method lookup phase semantics. Model lookup as typed outcomes: exact basic-type bypass, absent, any lookup exception consumed as absent at that reference boundary, or callable/noncallable result. After successful lookup, invocation/body/metadata/coercion errors follow their separate propagation rules.
impact: Only the declared reference lookup phase consumes lookup failure; diagnostics retain phase/context without observable callbacks, exceptions or ownership/lifetime changes. All returned opaque values preserve identity and any existing graph/AD behavior. This policy cannot hide kernel failures outside the source-defined phase.
remaining_design_or_execution: Required concrete provider typed-error/extension design review remains pending. Source definition does not approve implementation or qualify execution.
